notes.subject: תתימרו
notes.rationale: root ימר 'exchange/boast': 'boast yourselves' (KJV/ASV) vs 'revel' (JPS) vs 'exchange places with' — mi tanim olsem 'gladyim' (glady long glori bilong ol).

notes.subject: חיל
notes.rationale: חיל em i strong/ol samting gut/ol man i pait; mi tanim olsem 'ol samting gut' long ples bilong 'strep'.

notes.subject: יקראו/יאמר
notes.rationale: Tupela pasin bilong tok (singautim nem + tok) i stap wantaim — relatim nem 'pris bilong Yahwe' na 'wokman bilong Elohim bilong yumi'.

translation: Na yupela, ol bai singautim yupela olsem ol pris bilong Yahwe, olsem ol wokman bilong Elohim bilong yumi, ol i tok long yupela; yupela bai kaikai ⟨את⟩ ol samting gut bilong ol lain olgeta, na long glori bilong ol yupela bai gladyim.
